_doc: Manual-Migration-Manifest. Jede SQL-Datei in db/manual/ bekommt einen Eintrag. Die Felder beschreiben, was sich nach Anwendung der Migration in db/01_schema.sql wiederfinden muss (expect_in_schema) bzw. dort nicht mehr existieren darf (forbid_in_schema). Der Test 'SchemaParityTests' prueft beide Richtungen plus 1:1-Abdeckung zwischen Manifest und Verzeichnis. Workflow: neue Schema-Aenderung -> 01_schema.sql aktualisieren -> db/manual/<datum>_<name>.sql anlegen -> Eintrag hier ergaenzen. Siehe db/manual/README.md.

migrations.description: Renames workflow_definitions.approval_task_template_key to approval_spec_key and the matching check constraint to ..._approval_spec.
Adds directory_identities.job_title for Entra job-title import.

Adds workflow cancellation columns (cancelled_at, cancelled_by_person_id, cancellation_reason_code, cancellation_reason_detail) on public.workflows and extends both workflows.status and workflow_tasks.status check constraints with 'cancelled'.

Adds Windows-Worker support to the Automation Layer (Migrationspfad-Etappe 9a Schritt 2): target_runtime/claimed_at/claimed_by/heartbeat_at/completion_processed_at/completion_claimed_at on automation_jobs, output_json on automation_job_attempts, target_runtime on action_definitions, plus polling indexes and the automation_jobs_windows_worker view.

Data-only seed for Migrationspfad-Etappe 9a Schritt 3 Sub-B: inserts action_definitions row 7 (CreateAdUserLdaps, target_runtime=windows_worker) parallel to the existing simulated CreateAdUser (ID 1). Idempotent via ON CONFLICT (action_key) DO NOTHING.

Adds automation_job_attempts.failure_kind (Migrationspfad-Etappe 9a Schritt 4 Sub-A) plus named check constraint. Worker schreibt 'permanent' oder 'transient'; WorkflowAutomationRetryPolicy nutzt den Marker fuer sofortige FinalFail-Entscheidung bei klar permanenten Fehlern.

Data-only seed for Migrationspfad-Etappe 9a Schritt 5 Sub-B: inserts action_definitions row 'AssignGroupsLdaps' (target_runtime=windows_worker, handler_type=windows_worker_ldaps_groups) parallel to the existing simulated AssignGroups (ID 3). Idempotent via ON CONFLICT (action_key) DO NOTHING; no fixed ID to avoid collisions with existing dev DBs.

Data-only seed for Migrationspfad-Etappe 9a Schritt 5 Sub-C: inserts action_definitions row 'SendWelcomeMailGraph' (target_runtime=NULL, handler_type=graph_welcome_mail) parallel to the existing simulated SendWelcomeMail (ID 5). Linux-side handler using Graph App-only auth. Idempotent via ON CONFLICT (action_key) DO NOTHING; no fixed ID; no notification_templates row insert (Catalog-Default is the canonical source).

Migrationspfad-Etappe 9a Schritt 6 Sub-A: creates temporary_credentials table (pgcrypto symmetric vault for AD initial passwords). Worker writes via pgp_sym_encrypt in same Tx as MarkJobSucceededAsync (Sub-B); SendWelcomeMailGraphHandler reads/decrypts at run-time (Sub-C). Unique(workflow_node_instance_id, credential_type) makes the atomic vault write idempotent. GRANTs for kauth_worker (INSERT) and kauth_api (SELECT, UPDATE) are conditional via pg_roles lookup.
